audit.whatIsWrong: The chart reads Lucian / Skill x5 / Lucian while its own whys read even, Lucian, Lucian, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot — the packet chart exactly. The page shows Lucian winning the late game its prose says he 'can't fight you straight up' in.
audit.why: Lucian abuses levels 2-3 with the Lightslinger rhythm and the E dash; the lane inverts at 4-6 once Urgot out-bulks him and the R execute threatens a squishy frame, and stays inverted. Only the side tokens were stale.
audit.corrected: All seven rows as matched full+content pairs to the packet chart, ratings realigned, and the three early phase whys rewritten to state the real reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: Relentless Pursuit is treated as a fixed cooldown to wait out; nothing says it is shortened every time he lands a Lightslinger double-shot.
audit.why: Counting to 16 seconds is wrong advice against a Lucian who is auto-attacking the wave — the dash comes back far sooner. The player has to count his attacks, not the clock, or the 'engage when it's down' rule fires into a dash that is already up.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d now state the 16s rank-1 figure AND that Lightslinger attacks reduce it.
sources: enemyKit E cd 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 and text: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown'

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction in this matchup appears nowhere: Lightslinger empowers Lucian's next two attacks with bonus magic damage whenever a nearby enemy champion is IMMOBILIZED — and Urgot's Disdain flip and Fear Beyond Death both immobilize. The page tells you to flip him on cooldown without ever saying the flip itself arms his passive.
audit.why: It inverts the advice for poke trades: an E-flip used to chip rather than to kill hands Lucian two empowered shots for free. The flip is still correct as a kill commit, but not as a trade opener. Also wants.you[2] says 'build early armor so his double-shot poke stops trading even' — the empowered portion is magic damage, so armour does not answer it.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d rewritten to state the immobilize-empowers-Lightslinger rule and to restrict the flip to kill commits; wants.you[2] corrected on the damage type.
sources: ownerKit E and R hardCC flags

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text calls Lucian 'a squishy ADodo top'.
audit.why: Typo for ADC, shipped on a paying page.
audit.corrected: Fixed to ADC and the sentence tightened to name Disdain.

edits.before: Q start for safe poke. Each auto fires an Echoing Flames leg — chunk Lucian on every last-hit, but don't burn all six legs into one trade.
edits.after: Level 1 is the wave: don't step into a Lightslinger double-shot for one last-hit, and take Q for safe chip off the melees.

edits.before: E or W second depending on kill pressure. A landed E-flip into W spray already wins most level-2 exchanges outright.
edits.after: Piercing Light plus the double-shot out-trades your slow frame at 2 — his Q is 9s at rank 1, so farm between them.

edits.before: Full legs rotation online — this is your lane now. Walk Lucian down with W whenever Relentless Pursuit is on cooldown.
edits.after: His E keeps him outside Purge's 490 range and Lightslinger shots cut its cooldown — take CS under tower, don't chase.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1, but his Lightslinger shots cut it — count his attacks, not just the clock.

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His dash, 16s at rank 1 and shortened by every Lightslinger double-shot.

edits.before: Standing still and face-tanking while W sprays — without rotating fresh legs or landing E, Lucian simply walks through the spray and out-damages you.
edits.after: Your flip immobilizes him, which empowers his next two Lightslinger shots with bonus magic damage — flip to kill him, never to poke, or you hand him the trade.

edits.before: Build early armor so his double-shot poke stops trading even
edits.after: Buy early armour; his empowered shots add magic damage

edits.before: You dominate side-lane: Lucian is a squishy ADodo top who can't duel your tankiness, and your R execute plus E-flip catch removes him the moment he oversteps to farm.
edits.after: You dominate side-lane: Lucian is a squishy ADC top who cannot duel your tankiness, and your R execute plus the Disdain flip remove him the moment he oversteps.

notes: Best find here: Lightslinger's immobilize trigger. Urgot's own E-flip and R are hard CC, so committing the flip as a poke tool arms Lucian's next two attacks with bonus magic damage — the page previously said 'flip him on the cooldown' with no caveat at all. Second: Relentless Pursuit's cooldown is reduced by his Lightslinger attacks, so the whole 'wait for the dash' framework needed the attack count, not just 16s. The chart's whys already matched the packet; only side tokens were stale, and the mirror's row 4-7 flip agrees with this direction. Per the mirror, I did NOT touch the recurring claim that Urgot's W and passive deal percent-max-HP damage — Riot's text says only 'physical damage' and there is no percentHealth flag in his kit; it is champion-level and needs a sweep.
